name: Hugues de Payens
original_name: ユーグ・ド・パイヤン
source:
Based on Hugues de Payens, who was the co-founder and first Grand Master of the Knights Templar. With Saint Bernard of Clairvaux, she created the Latin Rule, the code of behavior for the Order.

She seems to be working hard for the world without anyone knowing.

"Could the King of Zipangu be her..."
